load_dataset_scenarios_recursive: recursively discover all scenario JSON files from a dataset directory tree
load_dataset_scenarios_with_limit: load scenario files from a directory with a maximum count limit applied
load_dataset_scenarios_with_subset: filter discovered scenarios to only those listed in a subset manifest file
effective_output_dir_mirroring: compute a mirrored output directory path that preserves the relative subdirectory structure of a scenario
load_subset_ids_from_manifest: parse a subset manifest JSON file and return all scenario IDs across all splits
